books.title: 8.03SC Physics III: Vibrations and Waves (Fall 2016 (scholar course))

units.title: Exam 1: oscillators and coupled systems
examples: classify damping from a measured x(t) graph
beat period of two superposed cosines
symmetry matrix of a three-mass chain with mirror symmetry
mechanical–electrical analogy: mass and spring constant in an LC circuit
vibration-isolation table: driven damped oscillator excited through the floor; amplitude response
three coupled masses (springs and pendulums): normal-mode frequencies and vectors

units.title: Exam 2: waves
examples: short questions: boundary condition of an EM wave at a conductor and similar
plasma waves: dispersion relation, allowed frequencies, group and phase velocity
plane wave E-field: propagation direction, ω and λ, B-field and Poynting vector
string with a fixed end and a free ring: normal modes and initial-shape decomposition

units.title: Practice Final Exam 1
examples: TE mode in a rectangular waveguide: boundary conditions, cutoff
two masses coupled by an elastic band to walls: normal modes
optical fibre acceptance angle (total internal reflection)
N-slit pattern: read slit number, spacing and width from an intensity graph
struck string: normal modes and amplitudes from an initial velocity profile (Fourier)
oscillating charge on a spring: radiated field and power (Larmor)
